scope: All numerical results in Section 2 of author reprint arXiv:0907.4010v1: Tables 2.1, 2.2 and Figure 2.1; no multivariate empirical claim.
methods: one-sided exponential; both uniform and capped exponential on every two-sided setting
rng: NumPy PCG64DXSM, independent SeedSequence child per cell/method
acceptance_intervals: pointwise Wilson 95%; all cell results retained
moment_check: accepted iid samples vs quadrature first/second moments; z=(sample_mean-target)/MCSE; descriptive, no pass based on pointwise tests
cdf_check: one-sample KS descriptive per cell/method; no aggregate superiority inference
boundary_grid: a=0..4 inclusive, step0.01; compare original formula to algebraically independent equal-acceptance root
timing: Recorded only as execution provenance, no hardware speed comparison
